verdict.rationale: Weave provides @weave.op() decoration that captures code, inputs, outputs, and execution metadata automatically, plus automatic token usage and cost tracking for supported LLM integrations, with traces surfaced in a UI trace tree/calls table. This is corroborated by GitHub repo descriptions confirming tracing of inputs/outputs across multiple LLM providers. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of latency capture accuracy and hands-on developer reviews beyond vendor docs/GitHub.
